story_review.one_viewing_summary: Planned chain: water reaches a San Antonio yard before the phone warns. A disclosed prototype charges from light, its four optical lenses light as water rises, its chip judges risk locally and its radio reaches a hub map. A held board shows the 98.82% validation figure, and a technician stamps a blank field result and reads a pinless map. The film then returns to the yard, where only a dashed, unlit goal outline is ringed at the curb.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on a yard with no station and a late warning. It now ends in that yard with deployment drawn honestly as an unlit planned outline and a still-dark phone. That answers the opening without inventing an installation, but the final 1.6 s camera whip leaves too little time to read either image.
